This page lists 43 Cursor keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `cursor.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Cursor to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t cursor.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/cursor.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Cursor.app`; if Cursor lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘I` | Toggle Sidepanel |
| `⌘L` | Toggle Sidepanel |
| `⌘E` | Toggle Agent layout |
| `⌘.` | Mode Menu |
| `⌘/` | Loop between AI models |
| `⇧⌘J` | Cursor settings |
| `⇧⌘Space` | Toggle Voice Mode |
| `⌘,` | General settings |
| `⇧⌘P` | Command palette |

## Chat

Focus on chat panel first.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⏎` | Nudge (default) |
| `⌃⏎` | Queue message |
| `⌘⏎` | Force send message |
| `⇧⌘⌫` | Cancel generation |
| `⇧⌘L` | Add selected code as context |
| `⌘V` | Add clipboard as context |
| `⇧⌘V` | Add clipboard to input box |
| `⌘⌫` | Reject all changes |
| `⇥` | Cycle to next message |
| `⇧⇥` | Rotate between Agent modes |
| `⌥⌘/` | Model toggle |
| `⌘N` | New chat |
| `⌘R` | New chat |
| `⌘T` | New chat tab |
| `⌘[` | Previous chat |
| `⌘]` | Next chat |
| `⌘W` | Close chat |
| `esc` | Unfocus field |

## Inline Edit

Press ⌘K in editor to start.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘K` | Open inline edit |
| `⇧⌘K` | Toggle input focus |
| `⏎` | Submit |
| `⇧⌘⌫` | Cancel |
| `⌥⏎` | Ask quick question |

## Code Selection & Context

Select code in editor first.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘L` | Add selection to Chat |
| `⇧⌘K` | Add selection to Edit |
| `⌘L` | Add selection to new chat |
| `⌘M` | Toggle file reading strategies |
| `⌘→` | Accept next word of suggestion |
| `⌘⏎` | Search codebase in chat |

## Tab

When suggestion appears.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇥` | Accept suggestion |
| `⌘→` | Accept next word |

## Terminal

Focus on terminal panel first.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘K` | Open terminal prompt bar |
| `⌘⏎` | Run generated command |
| `esc` | Accept command |

## Template file

The full [`cursor.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/cursor.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
